# Per-repo samples for the vendored gate contract tests (OPS-5.3).
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. test_tier_gate.py is vendored byte-identically into every
# repo carrying the gate, so it cannot hardcode paths from any one of them. It used
# to DERIVE a low-risk sample by probing candidate paths against tier-floor-paths.txt
# - which was unsound: exhausting a fixed candidate list does not prove a repo has no
# low-risk path, so ordinary floor patterns could silently skip real assertions
# (codex). Declaring the samples here removes the guesswork; the suite then VALIDATES
# each one against the real gate and FAILS if the declaration is wrong.
#
# Format: key = value. Both keys are required.
#
#   low_risk   a path this repo does NOT floor. The suite asserts tier_gate.py
#              agrees; if it does not, the tests fail rather than skip.
#   change_md  a path whose basename is CHANGE.md, used for the vendored-ticket
#              cross-validation. Declare one this repo does not floor when possible.
low_risk = docs/notes.md
change_md = CHANGE.md
